rules.statement: A purchaser in execution cannot successfully rely on section 344 of the Civil Procedure Code to set aside a sale if there is no proof of fraud or misrepresentation.
rules.supporting_quote: "The matter, therefore, really turns on the question of fact, which I have indicated. In my opinion the materials in the case do not amount to proof of fraud."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 344 of the Civil Procedure Code
